about_the_game:
Nightmares have invaded everyone's dreams, and those in distress will enter an endless cycle of nightmare devastation. Only players can delve into dreams, use cards to build dream cities, summon dream creatures, and fight for every victory in resisting nightmares. When players embark on the path of rescue, the unlocked new cards and abilities will help them resist nightmares

The card of strategy

Unlock the required deck and use randomly generated cards to build cities or enhance strength, giving you the ability to fight against Nightmare's attacks

Versatile architecture

Reasonably arrange buildings to merge them into one or transform their form, resulting in stronger buildings

Powerful equipment

Forge equipment, select the most suitable equipment for living beings, and enhance their strength

The Harvest of Dreams

Every confrontation can yield rewards, and the enhanced strength will be a powerful support for the next confrontation
